beats.text: Read The Case Against This Book before accepting the larger institutional interpretation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The fuller comparisons ask which pathways operate, for whom, and under which conditions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Their value lies in connecting social responsibility with the limits of what studies establish.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to understand why treating suffering and examining its environment belong in the same inquiry.
